FUNCTION red_Nnumber, value, ndigits ;+ ; NAME: ; NNUMBER ; PURPOSE: ; Convert an integer to a string with leading 0s ; CATEGORY: ; Type conversion ; CALLING SEQUENCE: ; RESULT = NNUMBER ( INT, DIGITS ) ; INPUTS: ; INT : Value for string, converted to integer. ; DIGITS : Number of max. digits for the string ; OUTPUTS: ; String of length DIGITS with leading zeroes ; MODIFICATION HISTORY: ; 15-Dec-1992 P.Suetterlin, KIS ;- sv = strtrim(fix(value), 2) num = n_elements(sv) sval = strarr(num) FOR k = 0, num-1 DO BEGIN svl = strlen(sv(k)) sva = '0' FOR i = 2, ndigits DO sva = sva+'0' strput, sva, sv(k), ndigits-svl sval(k) = sva ENDFOR IF num EQ 1 THEN $ return, sval(0) $ ELSE $ return,sval END
